basis: The 'Coal vs Gas' chart shows two trend lines. At the 2010 checkpoint on the x-axis, the blue line (Coal, left axis) is at a high point, visually around the 8-9 range. The red dashed line (Gas, right axis) is at a much lower point, labeled '5.48'. Comparing the vertical positions on their respective axes, the Coal line is significantly higher than the Gas line in 2010. Therefore, Coal has the larger residential consumption level.
option_label: Route 2010 Coal to priority residential supply follow-up
